subject: CPPO reseller evidence catalog + co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Carina Gomez <carina@cloudresell.com>

Cc: Miguel Alvarez <m.alvarez@cloudresell.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: what evidence do we need to activate CPPO for Redwood listing?

Hi Vanessa —

We’re rounding up the materials our finance and compliance teams need to get the CPPO (partner private offer) live for Redwood on the AWS marketplace. AWS asked for a consolidated evidence bundle and SKU entitlement mapping so we can finish their activation checklist and enable co-sell.

Two specific asks from us: a) a short checklist we can hand to our procurement and legal teams (they want one page), and b) the SKU -> subscription mapping so our billing system can match invoices.

Can you share the required artifacts and a short timeline? Also looping in Miguel (ops) who will own the entity mapping on our side.

Thanks — Carina
Carina Gomez
Partnerships Lead | CloudResell Ltd
carina@cloudresell.com
+1 415 555 0189

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: what evidence do we need to activate CPPO for Redwood listing?

Carina — great to hear from you and excited to get CloudResell onboarded. High level we can deliver a concise evidence catalog + a SKU entitlement matrix. I’m attaching a stub list below and will send the full zip by EOD.

What we’ll provide (attached):
- SOC 2 Type II summary + pointer to full report (redacted PII)
- KMS-encryption architecture note + HSM/KMS key ownership language
- Data residency and retention policy (regional entitlements)
- SKU entitlement matrix (SKU -> product SKU -> marketplace SKU -> billing code)
- Entity info & invoice payee template for AWS settlement

Immediate asks for CloudResell:
1) Confirm legal entity name(s) to appear on the invoice and tax docs.
2) Send the customer-facing SKU mapping you currently use (if any) so we can reconcile differences.

Tentative timeline: send the evidence bundle today (EOD PT), you review Wed, finalize by Thu for AWS activation next week. If the AWS partner team needs anything else we’ll loop them in.

Action owners: Ben will handle SKU entitlement mapping review, Soojin will validate compliance artifacts, Jonas will coordinate the AWS CPPO activation steps.

Will push the zip to you shortly.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 650 555 4021

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: what evidence do we need to activate CPPO for Redwood listing?

Adding a few operational details and the SKU template I just prepared (attached as stub). Key items to confirm with CloudResell:
- Which of their SKUs will map to our sandbox vs prod SKUs (we support delayed provisioning for trial SKUs).
- Their invoice remit-to and GL codes so AWS settlement maps correctly.
- Whether they will use consolidated billing or direct invoicing for end customers (this affects entitlements).

Technical note for Soojin / Irene: SOC2 summary is in the bundle but CloudResell may request the specific control narratives around encryption in transit (TLS) and access logs. I’ve flagged the relevant sections.

Carina / Miguel — attaching: sku_entitlement_matrix_v2.xlsx (stub), and the ppo-evidence-bundle zip (stub). If you can send the entity names and remit info today, we’ll aim to submit to AWS CPPO console tomorrow and request co-sell enablement.

Ben Carter

- Legal entity confirmed: CloudResell Ltd (EIN 12-3456789).
- Remit / invoicing: finance@cloudresell.com (payee CloudResell Ltd) — GL codes attached in follow-up.
- We prefer consolidated billing to keep settlement clean.
